comparison.objective: Candidate removes one fan; record rearranges six bottles across crowded vertical shelves.
comparison.physical_skill: Release-dependent top withdrawal versus repeated upright grasping, shelf transfer, collision avoidance, and stable placement.
comparison.success_condition: Fan placed with cage/neighbors seated versus all bottles sorted, no tilt/fall/bounds fault, grippers withdrawn, and 2 s stability.
comparison.reason: Crowding is shared context only; the tested sorting and upright-placement abilities differ.
